Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

“Isn’t it silly when a netrunner struts about in rags when elegance is so easily achieved? The color — it brings out my eyes, non? I do adore it. And the jacket is functional? How charming. Spinal cooling, some delightful cyberware, and all these adorable little safeguards. Magnifique.” - Aurore Cassel

A Bodyweight Clothing Kit can be combined with any Fashion Jacket to turn it into a body-only piece of a Bodyweight Suit with the appearance of the appropriate fashion. Each kit can make one piece of Body Armor, which cannot be un-Combined. Bodyweight Suits modified by this kit function as normal, but are not worn on the user’s head.

Type: Kit (Fashion Jacket)
Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Armor Enhancement rules: one Enhancement per piece of armor (armor worn on both body and head counts as one piece); not for cyberware armor (Skinweave, Subdermal Armor) or armor that's part of an ACPA or vehicle; SP limits use the armor's fully repaired SP; a Tech installs or removes one in 1 hour with no check; they don't count as Tech Upgrades for Upgrade Expertise. Armor Attachments have no limit per armor unless stated.
  • In Foundry, replace the jacket with a body-only Bodyweight Suit armor item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Enhancements & Kits).
